name: Aulin NT Assault Rifle
flavor: The ubiquitous, mass-produced workhorse of the galaxy.

name: Kodiak MK-IV Pulse Rifle
flavor: A heavy-duty, military-grade energy rifle used by professional corporate security.

name: Vanguard 'Ironclad' Repeater
flavor: A heavy, bulky ballistic rifle known for never jamming, even in mud or vacuum.

name: Stellaris Dynamics L-7 Las-Rifle
flavor: A sleek, lightweight civilian energy weapon with a synthetic white stock.

name: 'Pioneer' Stamped-Kit Rifle
flavor: A mass-produced, flat-packed kinetic rifle famous for being easily repaired almost anywhere with basic hand tools.

name: Pre-War 'Governor' Lever-Action
flavor: An antique wooden-stock rifle from before the galactic expansion.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Needle-Carbine
flavor: An overly complex, ridiculously expensive weapon that fires frictionless smart-flechettes.

name: Omni-Corp 'Peacekeeper' Scout Rifle
flavor: Standard issue for frontier patrols; cheap, plastic, and easily replaceable.

name: Zastava K-99 Rail-Sniper
flavor: A devastating, shoulder-bruising magnetic accelerator rifle.

name: Frontier 'Trench-Sweeper' Scatter-Rifle
flavor: A rusted out, wide-spread kinetic rifle favored by miners and asteroid hoppers.

name: Aulin NT Sidearm
flavor: The companion piece to the NT Assault Rifle. Reliable, blocky, and completely devoid of personality.

name: Scrap-Iron Autopistol
flavor: A heavy, crude ballistic pistol manufactured from reclaimed ship plating. Cheap and prone to overheating.

name: K-77 'Supernova' Hand Cannon
flavor: A massively overpowered, high-caliber revolver favored by flashy bounty hunters.

name: Stellaris Dynamics L-2 Las-Pistol
flavor: A slick, pearl-handled energy emitter popular among wealthy civilians for personal defense.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Micro-Emitter
flavor: A cutting-edge, palm-sized holdout weapon that bypasses standard energy shielding.

name: Omni-Corp 'Enforcer' Mag-Pistol
flavor: Standard-issue sidearm for corporate mall cops. Includes biometric grip locks that constantly malfunction.

name: Pre-War 'Peacemaker' Revolver
flavor: A meticulously maintained six-shooter from Earth's ancient history. A true collector's piece.

name: Zastava 'Rat-Catcher' Machine Pistol
flavor: An inaccurate, rapid-fire sub-pistol designed to spray lead down narrow ship corridors.

name: Vindicator Plasma-Burst Pistol
flavor: A bulky, top-heavy sidearm that fires superheated plasma. Requires frequent venting.

name: Frontier 'Stinger' Derringer
flavor: A tiny, twin-barrel kinetic pistol that easily fits in an asteroid miner's boot.

name: Vanguard 'Avalanche' Rotary Gun
flavor: A massive, multi-barrel ballistic minigun. Requires an exoskeleton or zero-G just to handle the recoil.

name: Stellaris Dynamics L-99 Plasma Projector
flavor: A sleek, high-end demolition tool repurposed into a terrifying, sustained-beam weapon.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Singularity Launcher
flavor: Fires a contained, micro-gravitational anomaly. Prohibitively expensive and violates several galactic treaties.

name: Omni-Corp 'Crowd-Pleaser' Flak Cannon
flavor: Fires wide, suppressive bursts of shrapnel. Standard issue for corporate riot-control dreadnoughts.

name: Pre-War 'Brimstone' Flamethrower
flavor: A terrifying, archaic weapon that uses liquid fuel. Highly illegal to fire inside any pressurized ship or station.

name: Zastava K-200 Gauss Cannon
flavor: A shoulder-mounted magnetic accelerator that requires a heavy, humming backpack generator to operate.

name: Frontier 'Rock-Breaker' Mining Laser
flavor: An industrial laser ripped from an asteroid drilling rig and fitted with a crude trigger mechanism.

name: 'Junker' RPG (Rocket Propelled Grenade)
flavor: A highly volatile, welded-together explosive launcher. Often just as dangerous to the user as it is to the target.

name: Vindicator 'Siege-Breaker' Mortar
flavor: A portable, indirect-fire explosive lobber. Favored by entrenched mercenaries for clearing out fortified positions.

name: 'Goliath' Recoilless Cannon
flavor: A brutally simple, shoulder-fired kinetic tube designed to punch fist-sized holes through reinforced starship bulkheads.

name: Vanguard 'Talon' Combat Knife
flavor: A perfectly balanced, serrated tactical knife. The standard backup weapon for mercenaries across the sector.

name: Apex 'Pacifier' Stun Baton
flavor: A telescoping rod capable of delivering a non-lethal (usually) electrical shock. Standard issue for station security.

name: Saito 'Mono-Katana'
flavor: An elegant, synthetic-grip sword with an edge honed down to a single molecule. Favored by eccentric executives.

name: Terran Forge 'Brush-Cleaver' Machete
flavor: A heavy, stamped-steel blade originally designed for clearing alien flora, now frequently used for settling disputes.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Phase-Dagger
flavor: An illegal assassination tool. The blade vibrates at a frequency that allows it to passively slip through standard kinetic shielding.

name: Pre-War 'Slugger' Baseball Bat
flavor: A beautifully preserved wooden sports relic from Old Earth. Surprisingly effective at denting cheap armor.

name: Zastava 'Severance' Plasma-Axe
flavor: A brutal, heavy-duty boarding weapon. The superheated plasma edge can cleave through ship bulkheads and blast doors.

name: 'Shipbreaker' Titanium Sledge
flavor: A massive, two-handed blunt instrument meant for manual salvage operations in zero-G.

name: 'Trekker' Survival Hatchet
flavor: A cheap, mass-produced survival tool sold in hard plastic clamshell packaging. Popular with budget-conscious explorers.

name: Hephaestus 'Breach-Mace'
flavor: A heavy, gyro-stabilized club topped with a concussive explosive charge. Used by shock-troops to cave in reinforced fortifications.

name: Pistol Light Caliber: 30-Round Box
flavor: A standard paper box of light kinetic rounds. Cheap, reliable, and fits in a pocket.

name: Pistol Light Caliber: 100-Round Ammo Tin
flavor: A sealed metal surplus tin filled with loose kinetic rounds. Popular with scavengers.

name: Pistol Heavy Caliber: 12-Round Speed-Loader Pack
flavor: Two pre-loaded cylinders of high-velocity magnum rounds in blister packaging.

name: Pistol Heavy Caliber: 50-Round Case
flavor: A foam-lined hard case of heavy-hitting handgun ammunition.

name: Rifle Light Caliber: 30-Round Magazine
flavor: A single, pre-loaded polymer magazine. Grab and go.

name: Rifle Light Caliber: 120-Round Surplus Bucket
flavor: Literally a plastic bucket of assorted, reclaimed light rifle rounds.

name: Rifle Heavy Caliber: 20-Round Box
flavor: Match-grade heavy ballistics packed carefully into a cardboard slipcase.

name: Rifle Heavy Caliber: 100-Round Wooden Crate
flavor: A heavy, stamped-wood crate of armor-piercing kinetic rounds.

name: Scatter Shells: 12-Count Box
flavor: Standard buckshot, useful for clearing both asteroid pests and boarding parties.

name: Scatter Shells: 50-Count Bandolier
flavor: A wearable canvas belt stuffed with assorted scatter ammunition.

name: Thermal Battery: Single Charge Cell
flavor: A standard civilian-grade power pack for light energy emitters.

name: Thermal Battery: 4-Pack Civilian Bundle
flavor: A blister-pack of four charge cells. Often sold near the register as an impulse buy.

name: Plasma Cartridge: Single Coolant/Plasma Vial
flavor: A highly pressurized glass tube glowing with volatile superheated gas.

name: Plasma Cartridge: 6-Vial Tactical Rig
flavor: A reinforced chest-rig insert containing six military-grade plasma cartridges.

name: Gauss Spikes: 50-Spike Magnetic Cylinder
flavor: A heavy spool of solid tungsten spikes designed for magnetic acceleration.

name: Smart-Flechettes: 1000-Round Spool
flavor: An incredibly expensive, proprietary reel of micro-guided darts.

name: Autocannon Shells: 100-Round Disintegrating Belt
flavor: A heavy, slung belt of massive caliber rounds meant for rotary weapons.

name: Heavy Plasma Canisters: Single Industrial Canister
flavor: A thick, shielded cylinder originally used to fuel fusion torches.

name: Micro-Singularity Cores: Single Containment Casket
flavor: A humming, magnetically-sealed lockbox holding a highly illegal gravity anomaly.

name: Flak Canisters: 4-Pack Wooden Crate
flavor: Suppressive shrapnel payloads packed in protective sawdust.

name: Liquid Fuel: 10-Gallon Pressurized Tank
flavor: A dangerously volatile, heavy sloshing tank of archaic incendiary fluid.

name: Heavy Gauss Slugs: 10-Slug Depleted Uranium Mag
flavor: Solid slugs of dense, radioactive material. Warning labels cover the box.

name: High-Capacity Battery: Single Generator Pack
flavor: A heavy, backpack-sized power unit meant for industrial laser drills.

name: High-Explosive Rockets: 3-Rocket Lockbox
flavor: Three unguided, highly destructive projectiles in a stenciled metal case.

name: Mortar Shells: 4-Shell Crate
flavor: Indirect-fire explosive shells safely nestled in a shock-absorbent foam crate.

name: Kinetic Breaching Slugs: Single Tungsten Slug
flavor: A single piece of ordinance the size of a soda can, meant to destroy starship bulkheads.

name: Aegis Solar Mesh Hood
flavor: A lightweight, UV-reflective head covering favored by desert scavengers and sun-miners.

name: Aegis HUD-Cowl Helmet
flavor: A fully pressurized flight helmet featuring a real-time tactical overlay projected directly onto the visor.

name: Aegis 'Steady-Hand' Pressurized Gloves
flavor: Thick, vacuum-safe gloves with micro-gyros to prevent hand tremors during delicate spacewalk repairs.

name: Aegis Canvas Work Gloves
flavor: Tough, non-pressurized gloves woven from cut-resistant fibers. They smell faintly of engine grease.

name: Aegis Mag-Grip Work Boots
flavor: Heavy, non-pressurized boots with togglable electromagnets in the soles for zero-G environments.

name: Aegis Void-Tread Mag Boots
flavor: Fully pressurized, environment-sealed boots with integrated magnetic locks for exterior hull walks.

name: Aegis Fibroweave Pullover
flavor: A thick, insulating top layer that regulates body temperature and resists minor abrasions.

name: Aegis Fibroweave Trousers
flavor: Heavy-duty pants favored by mechanics, featuring reinforced knees and plenty of tool loops.

name: Aegis Smart-Goggles
flavor: Durable eye protection that syncs with nearby diagnostic tools to display basic telemetry.

name: Stellaris 'Voyager' Space Suit
flavor: A sleek, form-fitting civilian vacuum suit with chrome accents. Looks great, but offers minimal armor.

name: Stellaris 'Executive' Space Suit
flavor: A tailored, high-end pressure suit often worn by corporate VIPs traveling between stations.

name: Stellaris Clear-View Helmet
flavor: A stylish, bubble-style pressurized helmet offering an unobstructed 180-degree view of the cosmos.

name: Stellaris Obsidian Helmet
flavor: A slick, opaque black helmet with one-way vision glass and built-in noise cancellation.

name: Stellaris Comm-Link Helmet
flavor: A pressurized helm featuring an elegant, external antenna array for long-range communications.

name: Lyra 'Bubble' Void Helm
flavor: A mass-produced, brightly colored plastic helmet. Barely meets standard safety regulations.

name: Lyra Neon Crop-Top
flavor: A cheap, flashy, synthetic shirt popular in station nightclubs and recreational sectors.

name: Lyra Graphic Tunic
flavor: A casual, oversized shirt stamped with auto-translating corporate slogans.

name: Lyra Thermal Undershirt
flavor: A thin, brightly colored base layer meant to be worn under heavier, uncomfortable gear.

name: Lyra Cargo Pants
flavor: Baggy, synthetic trousers with an excessive number of un-secured pockets.

name: Lyra 'Second-Skin' Leggings
flavor: Form-fitting, brightly patterned athletic wear.

name: Lyra Station Shorts
flavor: Lightweight, breathable shorts strictly for climate-controlled station sectors.

name: Lyra Slip-On Loafers
flavor: Flimsy, comfortable footwear intended for indoor, gravity-controlled environments.

name: Lyra 'Speed-Star' Sneakers
flavor: Mass-market athletic shoes with flashing LEDs built into the soles.

name: Lyra High-Top Kicks
flavor: Retro-styled synthetic boots that offer absolutely zero ankle support.

name: Kessler 'Tundra' Space Suit
flavor: A bulky, heavily insulated suit designed for sub-zero planetary exploration.

name: Kessler 'Inferno' Space Suit
flavor: A thermal-reflective suit built to withstand the ambient heat of volcanic mining ops.

name: Kessler 'Wanderer' Space Suit
flavor: A rugged, highly durable exploration suit coated in dust-repellent polymers.

name: Kessler Heavy-Duty Helmet
flavor: A thick, blocky helmet designed to withstand micrometeorite impacts.

name: Kessler 'Panopticon' Helmet
flavor: Features a reinforced, wide-angle visor for maximum peripheral vision in unknown territory.

name: Kessler Articulated Pressurized Gloves
flavor: Heavy gauntlets with reinforced joints to prevent crushing injuries in a vacuum.

name: Kessler 'Grip-Tight' Pressurized Gloves
flavor: Vacuum-sealed gloves coated in a micro-suction material for climbing sheer surfaces.

name: Kessler 'Crater' Pressurized Boots
flavor: Massive, heavy-tread boots designed to leave footprints in alien soil.

name: Kessler 'Anchor' Pressurized Boots
flavor: Features deployable pitons in the toe for traversing icy or highly unstable terrain.

name: Arx Standard Issue Suit
flavor: A rigid, utilitarian, gray pressure suit. Completely devoid of aesthetic flair.

name: Arx Arc-Welder Mask
flavor: A heavy face shield with extreme polarization to protect against industrial flash-burns.

name: Arx Uniform Coverall Top
flavor: A stiff, non-pressurized work shirt that requires rigid posture to wear comfortably.

name: Arx Reinforced Jacket
flavor: A heavy canvas jacket lined with a thin layer of protective ballistic mesh.

name: Arx Utility Trousers
flavor: Blocky, symmetrical pants with exactly four strictly regulated pockets.

name: Arx Padded Knee Trousers
flavor: Industrial pants with thick, built-in knee pads for crawling through maintenance shafts.

name: Arx Steel-Toe Work Boots
flavor: Incredibly heavy, non-pressurized boots designed to stop dropped cargo crates from crushing toes.

name: Arx Deck-Tread Boots
flavor: Non-slip, thick-soled boots standard-issued to all hangar and dock workers.

name: Veles Bio-Sealed Hazard Suit
flavor: A bright yellow, non-pressurized suit designed strictly to keep pathogens and corrosive liquids out.

name: Veles Medical Scrub Top
flavor: An easy-to-clean, antimicrobial shirt favored by station medics and ripper-docs alike.

name: Veles Medical Scrub Bottoms
flavor: Lightweight, sterile pants that resist fluid absorption.

name: Veles Clean-Room Boots
flavor: Seamless, slip-on white boots designed to leave absolutely zero trace contaminants.

name: Veles Sterilization Gloves
flavor: Elbow-length, chemical-resistant gloves. Not rated for vacuum exposure.

name: Veles Rebreather Mask
flavor: A half-face respirator that filters out toxic fumes and airborne spores.

name: Veles Fluid-Resistant Apron
flavor: A thick, rubberized apron used in both surgery and xenobiology labs.

name: Veles Diagnostic Visor
flavor: A lightweight headband that projects patient vitals or chemical data over one eye.

name: Veles First-Responder Jacket
flavor: A highly reflective, durable jacket packed with secure pockets for medical supplies.

name: Aegis Pressurized Assault Helmet
flavor: A rugged vacuum-sealed combat helm featuring reinforced composite plating and a hardened quartz visor.

name: Aegis Anodized Flak Vest
flavor: A lightweight tactical vest treated with a hardened ceramic coating to deflect shrapnel and low-caliber rounds.

name: Aegis Active Energy Repulsor Vest
flavor: A high-tech chest rig humming with a micro-capacitor grid designed to disrupt incoming directed-energy beams.

name: Aegis Active Kinetic Repulsor Gauntlets
flavor: Armored gloves embedded with localized kinetic dampening fields that absorb the shock of heavy blows.

name: Arx Armored Space Suit
flavor: A heavy, industrial-grade pressure suit reinforced with steel plating over critical life-support nodes.

name: Arx Armored Lining
flavor: A rigid, fire-retardant sub-layer designed to be zipped inside standard work coveralls for basic protection.

name: Arx Heavy Industrial Gauntlets
flavor: Sturdy, reinforced work gloves lined with chain-mail weave to prevent lacerations in heavy industrial yards.

name: Arx Reinforced Greaves
flavor: Heavy steel-capped leg guards built to withstand industrial drops and hazardous worksite debris.

name: Veles Bio-Shield Combat Helmet
flavor: A sealed medical-combat helmet equipped with a multi-stage air filter and chemical-splash visor.

name: Veles Haz-Mat Tactical Visor
flavor: A lightweight, non-pressurized face shield treated to resist caustic sprays and bio-pathogen mists.

name: Veles Ballistic Medical Jacket
flavor: A heavy white-and-grey responder jacket with internal ceramic inserts protecting vital organs during rescue ops.

name: Veles Sub-Dermal Shielded Tunic
flavor: An impact-absorbent under-vest worn by field medics entering active station skirmishes.

name: Veles Acid-Resistant Leggings
flavor: Heavy synthetic trousers coated in a slick, non-reactive polymer compound.

name: Veles Sealed Combat Boots
flavor: Environmentally sealed tactical boots with slip-resistant soles built for slick laboratory or hangar floors.

name: Veles Impact-Damped Work Boots
flavor: Thick-soled boots with internal gel cushions to reduce fatigue during long shifts on station decks.

name: Kodiak 'Juggernaut' Armored Space Suit
flavor: A massive, military-spec vacuum suit featuring thick composite armor plating across all vital sectors.

name: Kodiak 'Centurion' Heavy Suit
flavor: An imposing corporate security vacuum suit built to project authority and absorb heavy sustained fire.

name: Kodiak 'Vanguard' Exploration Suit
flavor: A hardened, radiation-shielded pressure suit designed for hazardous planetary surface operations.

name: Kodiak Kinetic Breaching Shield
flavor: A heavy, deployable ballistic shield with a view-port designed to withstand concentrated kinetic rifle rounds.

name: Kodiak Riot Kinetic Wall
flavor: A wide, interlocking riot shield favored by corporate security details during station uprisings.

name: Kodiak Deflector Energy Aegis
flavor: A heavy barrier shield projecting a high-density localized magnetic field to catch incoming energy bolts.

name: Ironclad Scrap-Plate Helm
flavor: A crude headpiece hammered together from discarded reactor shielding and welded mesh.

name: Ironclad Boilermaker's Chest Rig
flavor: A patchwork leather harness bolted with curved pieces of industrial boiler wall.

name: Ironclad Salvage-Gasket Leg Guards
flavor: Asymmetrical leg plating fashioned from old pipe segments and secured with heavy duct tape.

name: Ironclad Pit-Fighter Gauntlets
flavor: Heavy work gloves reinforced with discarded machine teeth and jagged scrap metal.

name: Aulin 'High-Cap' Light Rifle Magazine
flavor: An extended polymer box magazine designed to fit standard light kinetic rifles.

name: Kinetic-Tek Magnum Speed-Loader
flavor: A spring-loaded aluminum cylinder that holds heavy caliber rounds for rapid revolver reloads.

name: Vanguard 'Drum' Heavy Rifle Magazine
flavor: A massive, spring-fed double drum that doubles the capacity of heavy caliber kinetic rifles.

name: Rustbelt Tube Extender
flavor: A stamped metal tube that screws onto the end of standard scatter-rifles, allowing for two extra shells.

name: Stellaris Dynamics Overcharge Battery
flavor: A heavy, elongated thermal battery block that provides significantly more shots before a required cooldown.

name: Kodiak MK-V Coolant Rig
flavor: A military-grade plasma cartridge extender with additional built-in venting fins to prevent overheating.

name: Zastava High-Feed Spool
flavor: An oversized, motorized spool of magnetic wire that feeds spikes into Gauss weapons at a faster rate.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Silk-Drum
flavor: A proprietary, ultra-lightweight carbon drum loaded with thousands of smart-flechettes.

name: Blackwood Ordnance Belt-Box
flavor: A heavy armor-plated box that holds a massive disintegrating belt of autocannon shells.

name: Ironclad Forge 'Scrap-Mag' Pistol Clip
flavor: A dented, salvaged light pistol magazine bound with industrial tape. Cheap and prone to minor feed hitches.

name: Aulin 'Vertebrae' Vertical Grip
flavor: A ribbed, synthetic foregrip that provides excellent vertical recoil mitigation.

name: Vanguard 'Trench' Angled Grip
flavor: A heavy, sloped aluminum grip favored for aggressive, close-quarters cornering.

name: Kinetic-Tek Ergo-Pistol Grip
flavor: A rubberized replacement handle modeled to fit the exact contours of the user's palm.

name: Stellaris 'Nimbus' Foregrip
flavor: A sleek, white synthetic grip with heat-dispersing micro-channels.

name: Ironclad Forge Rebar Hand-Stop
flavor: A literal piece of bent construction rebar, welded onto a crude attachment rail.

name: Zastava Mag-Grip
flavor: A heavy, insulated handle designed to protect the user's hand from magnetic coil burn.

name: Omni-Corp 'Enforcer' Bi-pod Grip
flavor: A cheap plastic vertical grip that springs open into a flimsy bipod. Breaks easily.

name: Tactical Weave Solutions (TWS) Rubberized Sleeve
flavor: A slip-on friction sleeve that fits over existing handles to provide better grip in wet environments.

name: Blackwood Ordnance Heavy Handle
flavor: A massive, bolted steel grip required just to wrangle the recoil of heavy ordinance.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Smart-Grip
flavor: A biometric locking handle that completely disables the firing mechanism if held by an unauthorized user.

name: Aulin 'Rigid' Core Stock
flavor: A fixed, no-nonsense polymer rifle stock. Uncomfortable, but nearly indestructible.

name: Vanguard Recoil-Pad Stock
flavor: Features a heavy gel-pad at the rear designed to absorb the bruising kick of buckshot and heavy rounds.

name: Stellaris Dynamics Skeletonized Stock
flavor: A minimalist, ultra-lightweight frame designed for agility and aesthetic appeal.

name: Ironclad Forge Welded Pipe-Stock
flavor: Two pieces of industrial copper piping welded together and wrapped in electrical tape.

name: Zastava K-Series Shock-Absorber
flavor: A heavily braced, spring-loaded stock built to handle the violent rearward force of magnetic acceleration.

name: Omni-Corp Collapsible Wire Stock
flavor: A thin, retractable metal brace meant for extreme close-quarters. Digs painfully into the shoulder.

name: Kodiak 'Juggernaut' Heavy Brace
flavor: A massive, locking shoulder brace designed to interface directly with powered combat armor.

name: Blackwood Ordnance Counter-Weight Stock
flavor: A rear assembly filled with dense lead shot to perfectly balance out top-heavy explosive launchers.

name: Frontier Wood-Carved Stock
flavor: A hand-carved, lacquered wooden stock. Adds a touch of vintage frontier charm to any weapon.

name: Apex 'Stabilizer' Arm Brace
flavor: A velcro strap and rigid rail system that locks a heavy handgun securely to the user's forearm.

name: Stellaris 'Lumen' Underbarrel Flashlight
flavor: A blindingly bright, wide-angle LED emitter powered by a micro-cell.

name: Aulin NT Target-Painter Laser
flavor: A standard red-dot laser emitter. Easily visible in smoke, but gives away your position.

name: Apex Motion-Tracker Node
flavor: A small, underbarrel display that pulses when large kinetic masses move nearby.

name: Kodiak 'Breacher' Strobe
flavor: A high-frequency strobing light designed to disorient and blind targets in dark corridors.

name: Vanguard Range-Finder Module
flavor: A side-mounted laser tool that continuously feeds exact distance-to-target data to a linked HUD.

name: Zastava Magnetic Anomaly Sensor
flavor: Detects hidden energy shields and cloaking fields, lighting up when pointed at concealed technology.

name: Omni-Corp 'Mall-Cop' Siren Detachment
flavor: An incredibly loud, pre-recorded audio deterrent speaker. Mostly just annoys people.

name: Ironclad Forge Duct-Taped Glowstick
flavor: A cracked chemical glowstick hastily bound to a rail mount. Good for about six hours.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Bio-Scanner
flavor: A passive scanner that highlights recent organic footprints and blood trails.

name: Blackwood Ordnance Friend-Foe Scanner
flavor: A bulky transceiver that communicates with station security IFF tags to prevent friendly fire.

name: Aulin 'Whisper' Suppressor
flavor: A thick, threaded tube that marginally quiets the report of light kinetic rounds.

name: Vanguard 'Dragon' Muzzle Brake
flavor: Vents expanding gasses aggressively to the sides, reducing recoil but deafening the user.

name: Stellaris Focusing Lens
flavor: An elongated crystal emitter that tightly focuses thermal energy for increased effective range.

name: Kodiak MK-V Cooling Shroud
flavor: A vented thermal jacket that rapidly draws heat away from a blistering plasma nozzle.

name: Zastava Accelerator Coil Extender
flavor: Adds an extra set of electromagnets to the end of the barrel, increasing projectile velocity.

name: Ironclad Forge 'Sawed-Off' Choke
flavor: A dangerously modified, hacked-off piece of scrap metal that drastically widens a scatter shell's spread.

name: Omni-Corp Riot Flash-Hider
flavor: A cheap, slotted cone that prevents the weapon's muzzle flash from blinding the shooter in dark areas.

name: Blackwood Ordnance Fluted Heavy Barrel
flavor: An incredibly thick, fluted steel barrel designed to survive thousands of rounds of sustained cyclic fire.

name: Frontier 'Loudener' Compensator
flavor: A flared, archaic funnel attachment designed purely to make the weapon sound more terrifying.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Frictionless Tube
flavor: An internal barrel sleeve coated in a proprietary zero-friction compound.

name: Aulin 'Clear-Pic' Holographic Sight
flavor: A reliable, battery-powered emitter that projects a crisp targeting reticle onto a pane of hardened glass.

name: Vanguard 'Deadeye' Prism Optic
flavor: A rugged, fixed-magnification ACOG-style scope built to withstand the punishing recoil of heavy kinetic rifles.

name: Stellaris Thermal-Overlay Scope
flavor: A high-end optical sensor that highlights organic heat signatures in bright contrast against cold station corridors.

name: Ironclad Forge Rad-Glow Iron Sights
flavor: Crude metal posts painted with a highly radioactive, luminous isotope. They glow brightly in the dark, but might cause long-term health issues.

name: Zastava 'Penetrator' X-Ray Optic
flavor: A heavy, specialized sniper scope that pulses micro-x-rays to outline targets hiding behind thin starship bulkheads.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Neural-Link HUD
flavor: Lacks a physical glass lens entirely; instead, it wirelessly beams a targeting reticle directly into the user's cybernetic optic nerve.

name: Omni-Corp 'Snap-On' Reflex Sight
flavor: A cheap, mass-produced plastic red-dot. Prone to losing its zero if bumped against a wall.

name: Kodiak MK-II Variable Orbit-Scope
flavor: A massive, long-range optic featuring an onboard micro-computer that automatically calculates bullet drop and atmospheric density.

name: Kinetic-Tek Smart-Counter Sight
flavor: A sleek optic that digitally syncs with the weapon's magazine, displaying a floating ammo counter right beside the crosshairs.

name: Apex Low-Light Amplifier
flavor: A tube-style optic that gathers ambient starlight or emergency station lighting and amplifies it into daytime visibility.

name: Aulin 'Pinpoint' Micro-Reflex
flavor: A miniaturized holographic dot sight designed specifically to sit flush on the slide of a sidearm.

name: Vanguard 'Trench' Ghost Ring
flavor: Heavy-duty, oversized iron sights designed for rapid target acquisition in claustrophobic ship-boarding actions.

name: Stellaris 'Stargazer' Astro-Optic
flavor: An extreme long-range scope equipped with polarizing filters to prevent the user from being blinded by solar flares.

name: Ironclad Forge Welded Tube-Sight
flavor: Literally just a piece of scrap copper piping welded onto a rail mount. It narrows your field of view, which technically helps you focus.

name: Zastava 'Oculus' Multi-Spectral Optic
flavor: A bulky, dial-operated scope that allows the user to cycle between thermal, night-vision, and electromagnetic viewing modes.

name: Tessier-Ashpool 'Pre-Cog' Predictive Sight
flavor: Utilizing a localized micro-processor, this sight projects a ghost-reticle showing exactly where a moving target will be in 0.5 seconds.

name: Omni-Corp 'Budget-Dot' Reflex Sight
flavor: An even cheaper red-dot variant. The battery life is abysmal, and the dot itself is notoriously blurry.

name: Kodiak MK-IV Orbital-Strike Designator
flavor: An absurdly over-engineered targeting scope that paints targets with a high-frequency laser meant to guide in ship-to-surface ordinance.

name: Kinetic-Tek 'Eye-Track' Smart Optic
flavor: A scope that monitors the user's pupil dilation and micro-movements, automatically adjusting the zoom level based on where they are looking.

name: Blackwood Ordnance 'Behemoth' Artillery Sight
flavor: A clunky, heavily armored optical array required to properly aim mortar tubes and flak cannons over long distances.

name: Nautilus 'Burner' Welding Torch
flavor: A heavy, rugged acetylene-equivalent torch used for patching bulkheads or cutting through derelict ship plating.

name: Nautilus Scrap-Yard Plasma Cutter
flavor: A bulky, two-handed cutting rig salvaged from an old mining mech. Ugly, but cuts through starship hulls like butter.

name: Nautilus Fusion Spanner
flavor: A heavy, motorized wrench capable of torqueing industrial bolts. Can double as a blunt weapon in a pinch.

name: Nautilus Core-Sampler Drill
flavor: A heavy rotary drill designed to extract deep mineral samples from asteroids.

name: Nautilus Zero-G Tether Winch
flavor: A magnetic belt-mounted spool of high-tensile carbon cable used to prevent drifting into the void during exterior repairs.

name: Nautilus Sonic Rust Remover
flavor: A handheld emitter that blasts high-frequency sound waves to strip rust and cosmic buildup off metal surfaces.

name: Nautilus Salvaged Micro-Generator
flavor: A heavy, dented power box meant for jump-starting dead airlocks. Smells faintly of ozone and burnt plastic.

name: Quasar 'Pinpoint' Laser Welder
flavor: A sleek, high-precision micro-welder favored by station engineers for delicate circuit-board and cybernetic repairs.

name: Quasar Pocket Multi-Tool
flavor: A high-end, compact device folding out into a dozen different precision screwdrivers, wire strippers, and micro-blades.

name: Quasar Mag-Lock Decrypter
flavor: An illegal, highly sought-after electronic skeleton key capable of brute-forcing standard corporate cargo locks.

name: Quasar Handheld Dosimeter
flavor: A reliable Geiger counter that clicks aggressively when pointed at unstable reactor cores or unshielded cargo.

name: Quasar Biosphere Analyzer
flavor: A portable sniffer that rapidly samples alien atmospheres for toxins, spores, and breathable oxygen ratios.

name: Quasar Optical Bore-scope
flavor: A flexible fiber-optic snake camera with a digital screen, used for inspecting clogged station vents and engine manifolds.

name: Quasar Electro-Soldering Iron
flavor: A rapid-heating pen tool for soldering microscopic circuitry. Battery powered for field use.

name: Breach-Tech Industrial Plasma Cutter
flavor: A professional-grade, perfectly calibrated plasma torch. Clean cuts, high heat, and extremely reliable.

name: Breach-Tech Hydraulic Spreader
flavor: The galactic 'Jaws of Life.' A massive, heavy pneumatic tool meant to force open jammed blast doors.

name: Breach-Tech Pneumatic Rivet Gun
flavor: A loud, heavy kinetic driver used to forcefully anchor hull plates together in a vacuum.

name: Breach-Tech Field Multi-Tool
flavor: A heavy, blocky multi-tool favored by combat engineers. Features a dedicated pry-bar and kinetic hammer function.

name: Breach-Tech Portable Jump-Box
flavor: A military-grade external capacitor bank capable of jump-starting a grounded shuttlecraft.

name: Nutri-Synth Nutrient Paste Tube
flavor: A heavily processed, flavorless slurry containing all essential daily vitamins. Dirt cheap and completely joyless.

name: Nutri-Synth 'Spicy-Beef' Ration Block
flavor: A vacuum-sealed brick of dehydrated textured protein. Highly popular among mercenaries for its long shelf life and tolerable taste.

name: Nutri-Synth High-Calorie Survival Bar
flavor: A dense, rock-hard bar of concentrated calories designed to keep an explorer walking for 48 hours on a single bite.

name: Frontier Water Filtration Straw
flavor: A simple, pocket-sized carbon filter that purifies stagnant or mildly toxic ground water on alien worlds.

name: Frontier Micro-Fusion Fire Starter
flavor: A reusable, spark-emitting block that uses a tiny fusion reaction to instantly ignite kindling in sub-zero environments.

name: Frontier Thermal Mylar Blanket
flavor: A tightly folded square of heat-reflective foil. Essential for surviving a sudden drop in life-support temperatures.

name: Atmos-Tech Standard O2 Canister
flavor: A small, pressurized bottle of breathable oxygen. Provides roughly two hours of air for standard hazard masks.

name: Atmos-Tech Vacuum Oxygen Tank
flavor: A heavy, twin-cylinder tank designed to mount to the back of a space suit for extended extravehicular activities.

name: Atmos-Tech Heavy-Duty Carbon Filter
flavor: A dense replacement puck for rebreather masks, capable of scrubbing heavy industrial fumes and caustic spores.

name: Med-Tek Basic Trauma Kit
flavor: A small, hard-plastic lunchbox containing bandages, coagulants, and basic splints.

name: Med-Tek Field-Surgery Kit
flavor: A heavy, fold-out medical case packed with auto-sutures, synthetic blood, and sterile surgical tools.

name: Med-Tek Anti-Radiation Injector
flavor: Also known as 'Rad-Flush.' A harsh, painful chemical cocktail that rapidly purges radioactive isotopes from the bloodstream.

name: Med-Tek Synthetic Skin Salve
flavor: A pressurized aerosol can that sprays a fast-hardening, sterile foam over severe burns and lacerations.

name: Kessler Deployable Bivouac
flavor: A heavy, compressed disc that pops open into a rigid, fully pressurized 2-person survival tent with its own micro-atmosphere.

name: Kessler Distress Geo-Locator
flavor: A durable, battery-powered radio box that broadcasts an encrypted SOS on all known galactic frequencies when activated.
